learnPolicy: Field Guide presents motifs and croppie readings as interpretations, not proven messages.

formations.title: Milk Hill (three-fold)
formations.meaning: Return to Milk Hill almost 25 years after the 2001 Galaxy. Croppie reading: a compact three-fold design that echoes pilgrimage memory more than the Galaxy's complexity. Threefold motifs are often read as balance, cycles, or trinity geometry.
readings: Site memory: Milk Hill Galaxy (Aug 2001), still the landmark Wiltshire formation.
Design: small three-fold vs ancestral spiral galaxy.
Landscape: Marlborough Downs edge, classic skywatch vantage.
formations.access: Historic croppie landscape; respect farmers and tramlines.
formations.imageCredit: Field Guide original schematic (not a drone aerial)
formations.imageNote: Replace imageUrl with licensed HTTPS aerial after written permission from photographer + Crop Circle Connector.

formations.title: Stone Circle, Avebury
formations.meaning: Formation reported beside Avebury's prehistoric stone complex. Readings usually braid crop geometry with temple rings, seasonal skywatch, and the idea that new circles answer old circles of stone.
readings: Place: World Heritage megalithic landscape.
Common croppie frame: stone-temple alignment and seasonal skywatch.
Field Guide tip: stay on rights of way; do not climb stones.
formations.access: Avebury World Heritage landscape: stay on public rights of way; do not climb stones.
formations.imageCredit: Field Guide original schematic (not a drone aerial)
formations.imageNote: Replace imageUrl with licensed HTTPS aerial after written permission from photographer + Crop Circle Connector.

formations.title: Wanborough Plain
formations.meaning: Late-July formation on the chalk below Liddington Castle and the Ridgeway. Ridgeway sites are often read as path, portal, or beacon motifs along Britain's ancient north-south spine.
readings: Landscape: Liddington Castle and Ridgeway corridor.
Common reading: path / portal / beacon along the Ridgeway.
formations.access: Check Connector for farmer access notes before entering crops.

formations.title: Walker's Plantation
formations.meaning: Commissioned for Sky History (Bradley Walsh series). Useful as a craft / media contrast: not every circle is a mystery claim; some are openly authored land art for camera.
readings: Provenance: commissioned television formation.
Learn angle: human craft vs unexplained folklore.
formations.access: NO PUBLIC ACCESS. Farmer request: do not enter. Pin is witness-from-path / desk-only.

formations.title: First Broad Drive

readings: Season opener energy: clean geometry before July's denser set.
Place: Grovely Wood western Wiltshire fringe.

formations.title: Roundway Hill
formations.meaning: First July Roundway report. Croppie nickname after Nick Bull's video: a face-on chicken with open beak (pareidolia; probably not intentional). Landscape is hillfort and Civil War battlefield, so martial / watchtower readings also circulate.
readings: Croppie: 'cosmic chicken' pareidolia from aerial video.
Landscape: Roundway Down hillfort / battlefield.
formations.access: Confirm access; Roundway Down is popular walking country.
formations.imageCredit: Field Guide original schematic (not a drone aerial)

formations.title: Roundway Hill (2)
formations.meaning: Second Roundway formation a week later on the same tramlines. Croppie notes unusual 13-fold geometry and echoes of 2021/2023 local circles; some visitors read a solar-eclipse herald. Paired-site season beat with the 11 July 'chicken'.
readings: Same field, same tramlines as Roundway (1).
Geometry: 13-fold; eclipse reading is speculative.
Echoes prior Roundway-area seasons (2021, 2023).

formations.title: Maccoombe Down
formations.meaning: Crisp three-dimensional design Croppie nicknamed an impeller. Connector comments cluster around: airplane window + six-blade propeller (UFO propulsion / spin-counterspin lore); ribbon-on-a-gift; six-pointed star in perspective; Sun–Sirius alignment on 7/7 (two sevens). Owner opened public access (first in 19 years).
readings: Visual: 3D impeller / propeller-in-a-window illusion.
Date lore: 7 July Sun–Sirius alignment; dual arrows / seven bars.
Other: gift ribbon, origami hexagram, Wheel of Destiny (Tarot X).
Access story: nest gift at centre; marked tracks only.
formations.access: PUBLIC ACCESS via marked tracks only. Park at junction with footpath/byway north of field. Harvest came soon after reporting.

formations.title: Etchilhampton Hill (poppy)
formations.meaning: Explicit poppy motif. Connector: remembrance, peace, and sleep (WWI battlefield flower and classical sleep symbolism).
readings: Motif: poppy = remembrance / peace / sleep.
Color and culture shift exact symbolism; red poppy is the UK Remembrance mark.

formations.title: Etchilhampton Hill (lion)
formations.meaning: Second Etchilhampton 2026 formation (Connector 'lion' page). Croppie: familiar yet ambiguous Op-Art, with undertones of the 2018 'sick teddy bear', recycling-symbol geometry, and a tongue-in-cheek 'psychedelic badger' reading. Paired with the June poppy on the same hill mass.
readings: Croppie: Op-Art ambiguity; recycling / teddy / badger pareidolia.
Pairing: answers the June poppy on Etchilhampton.
Season note: 2026 often recycles earlier-year silhouettes.
